quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to TextWorld! Please go east.

Welcome to another exciting episode of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, make an effort to move east. Once you accomplish that, take the cushion from the bookshelf within the bar. After that, try to go west. Once you succeed at that, go to the north. And then, sit the cushion on the shelf in the salon. Got that? Good!

objective: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First of all, attempt to go to the east. With that accomplished, pick up the cushion from the bookshelf within the bar. After getting the cushion, make an effort to travel west. That done, make an effort to go north. Then, put the cushion on the shelf. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
